Anya (Enablement): Hey team — prepping a 90-min enablement for LucentCare next Wed 10am PT. Need to lock agenda, owners for slides/demos, and any prework we should ask them to do. Can we cover Dedicated migration, prompt-tuning best practices, and dashboard walkthrough?
Jamal (Solutions): I can take the Dedicated migration section. Short demo + FAQ. Will need staging account creds.
Chris (AE): I'll confirm with the customer which migration path they prefer (lift+shift vs. phased). Pinged them — waiting reply.
Maya (CS): I'll do onboarding status and renewal touchpoints (15m). Also can surface any health flags.
Eve (DevEx): I'll own prompt-tuning & prompt library (20m) — want to include a tiny hands-on notebook. Do we have time?
Anya (Enablement): Plan is 90m total: 10m intro, 20m migration, 20m prompt-tune hands-on, 15m dashboards & observability, 15m Q&A + next steps, 10m buffer. Sounded tight but doable.
Jamal (Solutions): Fine. For the demo I'll need GPU pool quota check and a saved model snapshot. Can someone request quota to infra? @calendar-bot can you remind infra to approve once agenda final?
calendar-bot: Reminder set: request infra quota approval by Tue 5pm PT for LucentCare migration demo. :white_check_mark:
Chris (AE): Customer said they can share sample prompts and a small dataset two days prior. I'll ask for anonymization checklist.
Maya (CS): Also flagging renewal risk: LucentCare has usage plateauing last 3 weeks. I'll prepare a 1-slide health summary to share in meeting.
Eve (DevEx): For the hands-on, propose a tiny colab link + snippet:
```
# quick prompt dev template
PROMPT = "Summarize the patient note focusing on medication changes."
response = client.generate(model="r-infer-small", prompt=PROMPT)
```
Keep it offline-friendly and <10 tokens to demo.
Anya (Enablement): Love that. Owners: Jamal (demo infra + migration), Eve (hands-on notebook), Maya (health + post-mortem playbook), Chris (customer prework ask). I'll draft agenda slide and circulate by EOD Mon.
Jamal (Solutions): Confirming I need staging creds and quota by Tue. I'll add a short rollback plan slide too.
Chris (AE): Customer prework ask to include: 1) share 5 sample prompts, 2) access to a representative dataset (sanitized), 3) a list of their current latency/cost targets. I'll send that note tonight.
Maya (CS): For the renewal angle, I'll include two recommendation tracks: cost-optimization + reliability improvements. Want to keep that to 2 slides.
Anya (Enablement): Nice. Can we get a 1-paragraph meeting objective for the invite? Something like: "Align on migration approach, demo prompt tuning flow, and next 30-day success plan" — tweak if needed.
Eve (DevEx): Works for me. Also, can we ask LucentCare to bring one engineer to the hands-on? Otherwise we'll demo only.
Chris (AE): I'll ask.
Anya (Enablement): Ok last: follow-up artifacts — recording, notebook, migration checklist, and a tailored cost estimate. Owners: Eve (notebook), Jamal (migration checklist & estimate), Maya (health follow-up). I'll send the invite after I get final owners confirm.
Jamal (Solutions): Confirmed.
Maya (CS): Confirmed.
Eve (DevEx): Confirmed.
Anya (Enablement): Calendar invite created: https://calendar.example.com/event?eid=abc123 — please add materials to the thread and ping me when done. :party:
calendar-bot: Event created for LucentCare Enablement — Wed 10am PT. Attendees: LucentCare, Jamal, Eve, Maya, Chris, Anya.
Chris (AE): Posted prework note to the customer.
Anya (Enablement): Thanks all — I'll compile slides and send a final checklist by Tue noon. If anything blocks, call out here. :v:
